title: Money: Rand and Cents, Totals and Change
seo_title: Grade 3 Money Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Recognise and identify the South African coins and bank notes; solve money problems involving totals and change in rands and cents; convert between rands and cents.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 3 maths worksheets: rand coins and notes, counting money, shopping totals and change. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Coins: 10c, 20c, 50c, R1, R2, R5. Notes: R10, R20, R50, R100, R200.
  • 100 cents make R1.
  • Shopping: add the prices. Change: subtract the price from what you paid.
  • Count on from the price to what you paid to check.

Examples

Example

Pay R50 for R37

R37 + R3 = R40

R40 + R10 = R50

Answer: R13 change

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting coinsAdd the values.
ChangeSubtract the price.
Cents and rands100c = R1.
